business_problem: ImpulsoGov needed to rebuild a public-health data platform so hundreds of municipalities could exchange preventive-care data faster, run pipelines in hours instead of days, and scale without proportionally increasing infrastructure costs.
solution_summary: ImpulsoGov uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: ImpulsoGov needed to rebuild a public-health data platform so hundreds of municipalities could exchange preventive-care data faster, run pipelines in hours instead of days, and scale without proportionally increasing infrastructure costs. Cloud Storage receives raw municipal health records from a transmitter application installed in each city and stores the bronze layer of the medallion pipeline, serving as the storage layer. Google Kubernetes Engine runs the orchestrator that processes and refines data across the medallion architecture, serving as the orchestration layer. BigQuery stores the silver and gold data layers used for analytics and decision support, serving as the storage layer. Cloud Run supports the applications that deliver the final data products to healthcare professionals, serving as the serving layer. Cloud SQL backs the applications that expose curated information to practitioners, serving as the storage layer.

is a Brazilian nonprofit healthtech that turns public health data into action. Brazil's universal health system covers 210 million people and holds the world's largest public health database. Yet despite this wealth of information, a preventable death occurs every nine minutes. ImpulsoGov's mission is to close that gap, helping municipalities use the data they already have to identify and reach the citizens who need care before it is too late.
data_flow: Each municipality sends daily records through a local transmitter into Cloud Storage, GKE orchestrates processing through a medallion architecture, BigQuery holds refined silver and gold layers, and Cloud Run plus Cloud SQL serve the final applications to healthcare professionals.
